verdict.rationale: Crossplane's control plane continuously reconciles managed resources against declared desired state and automatically corrects drift, as documented directly ('If your software ever drifts from your desired state, the control plane automatically corrects the drift'), and community commentary corroborates its active-controller reconciliation model versus static IaC tools. missing for 10: no explicit 'diff/plan' style drift report separate from auto-remediation, and no independent hands-on validation of drift detection behavior.
